settings.headline: Abacene Labs builds the usage ledger for API companies.
settings.subtitle: Founded (in the story) by two engineers who spent too many month-ends reconciling usage exports by hand. Abacene Labs, its people and customers are fictional.

settings.headline: Why we built it
settings.body:
Usage-based pricing is fair to customers and hard on finance. Most teams build metering once, then spend years answering “why is this line this number?”

Abacene is built around that question: every quantity on every invoice can be walked back to the events behind it.
